reason: We do the library storytime, parks and the zoo, and I almost never pay for kid activities. I'd maybe take the free first visit, but I wouldn't pay $13 a time when the free options already work.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid, so I won't really get to sit and drink coffee. Paying $13 a visit for something the library and park give me for free doesn't add up.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in price around $5 or a clearly free weekday session during my shift-off hours. Even then I'd need to see it's actually calmer than the free places.
